rules: Do not mutate n8n while canonical executions are running.
Do not structurally mutate n8n while Hunter downstream dispatches are open.
Create a verified pre-change snapshot before each bounded mutation tranche.
Preserve workflow identity, ingress contract, callback contract, and credentials unless explicitly authorized.
After each tranche, record graph/hash/version differences and run controlled validation.
Keep the pre-unfreeze baseline immutable as the recovery anchor.
